title: [GMCP 203.011.M] Mastery: Complete prompt and completion server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-011-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Prompt discovery/get and argument completion implement all current schemas, roles, embedded content, pagination/filtering, list changes, cache semantics, validation, cancellation, authorization, and deterministic ranking. Prompt templates are immutable per advertised version, untrusted substitutions remain data, and injection, oversized expansion, missing argument, localization, and concurrent-update cases are proven. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
limitations: Core serves the prompt and completion server role (`crates/susi-gmcp/src/{protocol,catalog,content,jsonrpc_gate,mcp/http}.rs`) across stdio (`susi mcp serve`), in-process `embedded_adapter`, Streamable HTTP (`/mcp` and `/messages`), and Unix-domain sockets (`#[cfg(unix)]`); Windows x86_64 covers stdio, embedded, and Streamable HTTP while Unix socket parity is gated `#[cfg(unix)]`.

The shipped `use_tool` prompt renders a bounded static template (`GetPromptResponse::Complete`, `resultType = complete`) without multi-turn `input_required` elicitation, and dynamic registration via `GmcpService::register_prompt` / `register_prompt_provider` is an in-process API without remote HTTP prompt mutation endpoints.

Mastery consumes and verifies retained, signed, non-mock JSONL evidence in `.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-011.jsonl` across `GMCP-203-011-01..06` and `-M` plus `.agents/roadmap.json` and `.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-011.json`.

reuse.reason: The prompt and completion server surface (crates/susi-gmcp/src/protocol.rs list_prompts/get_prompt/complete/register_prompt, catalog.rs, content.rs, jsonrpc_gate.rs, mcp/http.rs), inspectable CLI/ledger verifier (src/cli/mcp_cli.rs, crates/susi-gmcp/src/requirements_ledger.rs), and requirement harness helpers (tests/gmcp_requirements.rs StdioSession, embedded_adapter, socket_adapter, adapter_modern_meta, ledger_report, ledger_tool_report, evidence helpers) already exist in Susi Core; this mastery gate composes and verifies them end-to-end plus committed VC-203-011 evidence and roadmap verdict artifacts without duplicating server logic.
reuse.searched: Susi Core: crates/susi-gmcp/src/{protocol,catalog,content,jsonrpc_gate,mcp/http,requirements_ledger,server}.rs, src/cli/mcp_cli.rs, .agents/gmcp/{sources.json,requirements-ledger.json,evidence/VC-203-007.jsonl,evidence/VC-203-010.jsonl}, docs/gmcp/contract-203-011.md, .agents/roadmap.json, .agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-{007,010}.json, xtask/src/{gmcp_roadmap,gmcp_evidence}.rs, and tests/gmcp_requirements.rs.
